description: The most compatible MCP CLI client. Supports: Tools, Resources, Prompts, Completions, Tasks, Skills, stdio and streamable HTTP, MCP versions 2024-10-07 through 2026-07-28, persistent sessions, OAuth 2.1 with DCR, CIMD, client credentials, and ID-JAG, OS keychain, --json for code mode, grep for tool discovery, proxy for AI sandboxes, x402, and more.
vibe: Ruthless conciseness, outcome-first execution, and zero conversational waste.
highlights: This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
`mcpc` is a universal command-line client for the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/),
which maps MCP to intuitive CLI commands for shell access, scripts, and AI coding agents.
assessment: Structured `AGENTS.md` specification (~16469 est. tokens) codifying anti-slop minimalist guardrails and repository conventions.
